_meta.description: Comprehensive AI model database for NovaX Cloud Router. All providers, models, pricing, context windows, and capabilities.
_meta.note: Prices in USD per million tokens (MTok). Verify against official provider docs before production use.

claude-opus-4-6.notes: Flagship model. 1M context via context-1m-2025-08-07 beta header. Agent teams, 76% long-context retrieval.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Balanced performance/cost. Long-context pricing applies above 200K tokens.

claude-haiku-4-5.notes: Fastest and cheapest Claude. Best for high-volume simple tasks.

claude-opus-4-5.notes: Previous opus generation. Improved coding and workplace tasks.

claude-opus-4-1.notes: Legacy pricing — significantly more expensive than 4.5/4.6 generation.

claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219.notes: Introduced extended thinking / hybrid reasoning mode.

gpt-5-2.notes: Flagship model. Configurable reasoning effort (minimal/low/medium/high). Knowledge cutoff Aug 2025.

gpt-5-2-codex.notes: Specialized agentic coding. Context compaction, long-horizon tasks.

gpt-4-1.notes: 1M token context. Strong instruction following. Supports fine-tuning.

gpt-4o.notes: Still active in API. Native audio input/output capability.

o3.notes: Deep reasoning model. Uses internal reasoning tokens billed as output.

o4-mini.notes: Cost-efficient reasoning. Excels in math and coding.

gpt-oss-120b.notes: Open-weight. Most powerful single-H100 model. Available on Groq/Together.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: Most affordable OpenAI model overall. 1000+ t/s on Groq.

gemini-3-flash.notes: Free tier available in Google AI Studio.

gemini-2-5-pro.notes: Hybrid reasoning model with thinking budgets.

gemini-2-5-flash-lite.notes: Lowest cost Gemini 2.5 tier. High throughput.

gemini-1-5-pro.notes: 2M context window — largest ever offered by any mainstream model.

veo-3-1-generate-preview.notes: Available to paid tier Gemini API developers.

mistral-large-2512.notes: Flagship model. Largest context window in Mistral lineup.

mistral-medium-3.notes: GPT-4 class performance at significant cost savings.

magistral.notes: Specialized reasoning model. Multi-step logic and transparent reasoning chains.

mistral-nemo.notes: Most affordable Mistral. 12B params co-developed with NVIDIA.

llama-4-scout-17b-16e.notes: 10M context window — largest in Llama series. Fits single H100. Beats Gemma 3, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite.

llama-4-maverick-17b-128e.notes: Beats GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash on benchmarks. Best-in-class multimodal open model.

llama-4-behemoth.notes: Announced but still in training as of March 2026. Outperforms GPT-4.5, Claude Sonnet 3.7, Gemini 2.0 Pro on STEM benchmarks.

llama-3-3-70b.notes: Prior generation workhorse. Still widely used.

llama-3-1-8b.notes: Highly efficient. Popular for local deployment.

command-a-03-2025.notes: Most performant Cohere model. 256K context. Optimized for enterprise agentic tasks.

command-r-plus-08-2024.notes: Complex reasoning, multi-step tool use, RAG.

command-r-08-2024.notes: Balanced performance/cost. Good for general production apps.

command-r7b-12-2024.notes: Most affordable Cohere model. High-volume simple tasks.

deepseek-chat.notes: Alias pointing to deepseek-v3-2 as of Dec 2025.

deepseek-v3-2.notes: Default endpoint. Enhanced coding and math. Replaced R1 as default.

deepseek-v3-1.notes: Hybrid model — switches between thinking and non-thinking modes. Most affordable DeepSeek.

deepseek-v3-2-exp.notes: Research only. Gold-medal IMO/IOI results. No tool calling. Not for production.

deepseek-r1-0528.notes: Upgraded R1. Advanced reasoning and inference.

deepseek-v3-0324.notes: Improved post-training from R1 RL technique. Outperforms GPT-4.5 on math/coding.

deepseek-r1.notes: Comparable to OpenAI o1 on reasoning benchmarks. Open-source.

deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b.notes: Distilled. Retains most of R1 reasoning capability.

gpt-oss-120b.notes: 500+ t/s on Groq. Highest intelligence on platform.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: 1000+ t/s. Fastest model on Groq. Lowest cost.

kimi-k2-0905.notes: Largest context on Groq. High intelligence tier.

llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct.notes: Best multimodal open model. 80%+ cost reduction vs GPT-4o.

kimi-k2-5.notes: Highest intelligence tier on Together AI.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: OpenRouter is an aggregation layer, not a model provider. It proxies all major providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Meta, Mistral, xAI, Cohere, etc.) through a single OpenAI-compatible API. Pricing passes through at or near provider cost. Model IDs follow the pattern: 'provider/model-name'. Over 500 models available as of March 2026.
openrouter.api_notes: Use GET /api/v1/models for live full model list with current pricing. Response includes context_length, pricing.prompt, pricing.completion fields per model.
